review.notes: Full review of the repaired head. Previous R01, R03, R05 repaired; R02 repaired by a declared contract on EulerSystemsCyclotomicMainConjecture plus owned routes for Greenberg's structure theorem and CM reduction; R04 partly (cache line numbers and the p. 14 locator fixed; no sources.toml, as on main). New P2: the owned CM-reduction route assumes every cyclic p^n-quotient of a conductor-one CM curve has conductor exactly p^n, which is false for p split in K (witness K = Q(sqrt(-23)), p = 3, the ideal quotient C/O_K -> C/p^-1); Vatsal's p is auxiliary, so restricting to p inert, or an exact-conductor induction, repairs it. Three P3 (the Greenberg route's last inference, Stevens Theorem 7.1 on p. 104, the shape of the declared gap) and one P3 on the Theorem 1.11 hypotheses for twists with 7 dividing D.
